meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine
linking word: главное — это народ

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
meanings.note: case forms

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: 'это просто' = it's easy
это просто = it's easy

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'трясающий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('amazing, stunning').
savory meat paste dish

examples.trans: The chef prepares a signature pâté.
Chef, this is simply amazing pâté!

examples.text: Костя, быстро попробуй мой новый паштет.
examples.trans: Kostya, quickly taste my new pâté.

meanings.note: чн is pronounced шн

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: agrees with the thing owned
лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: specialty of the house

examples.text: Я могу приготовить своё фирменное блюдо.
examples.trans: I can prepare my signature dish.
The chef prepared his signature dish.

meanings.note: culinary instructions or doctor's prescription

examples.trans: Before you is a unique ancient recipe.

examples.text: Шеф хранит этот секретный рецепт в тайне.
examples.trans: The chef keeps this secret recipe confidential.

examples.text: Шеф хранит свой тайный рецепт супа.
examples.trans: The chef keeps his secret soup recipe.

meanings.note: contrast
starting a question: а жвачку?

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: in questions
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'дукт'). Common masculine noun meaning 'product, foodstuff' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Ты будешь целый день разгружать продукты!
examples.trans: You will unload groceries the whole day!
The guests need the freshest product!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: case forms

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: directional adverb

examples.trans: They put bad meat in there for you.

examples.text: Хочешь, сейчас и тебя туда увезут?
examples.trans: Want them to take you there too right now?

meanings.en: to put, to place, to lay down
meanings.note: + в/на + accusative

examples.text: В гроб с собой икру не положишь!
examples.trans: You can't put caviar in your coffin to take with you!
Put the keys on the table.

examples.text: А вот сюда я её и положу! Отличный подарок будет!
examples.trans: Right here is where I will put it! It will be an excellent gift!

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
Do you know the main thing?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('big, large').

examples.text: Аракелян просит время. Сумма очень большая.
examples.trans: Arakelyan is asking for more time. The sum is very large.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('personal, private').

examples.text: Всё, Нинок. Теперь у нас есть личный слуга.
examples.trans: That's it, Ninok. Now we have our own personal servant.

meanings.note: Borrowed via French 'secret' from Latin 'secretum' (something set apart or hidden).

examples.trans: These are our little men's secrets!

examples.text: А вы кем работаете, если не секрет?
examples.trans: And what do you do, if it is not a secret?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?
polite request

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

хотя.gloss: even if, at least (with бы); although

meanings.note: нужно хотя бы поговорить = we need at least to talk

examples.text: Нужно хотя бы поговорить с ними.
examples.trans: We need at least to talk with them.

examples.text: Вы плохо поступили, но хотя бы совесть есть.
examples.trans: You acted badly, but at least you have a conscience.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'екретный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('secret').

examples.text: А почему он на секретном совещании?
examples.trans: And why is he at a secret meeting?

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'ingredient' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: There are only the freshest ingredients there.

examples.text: Скажите хотя бы один секретный ингредиент.
examples.trans: Tell me at least one secret ingredient.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: to guess, to work out, to think of
meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'гадаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to guess, to realise', paired with 'догадываться'.

examples.trans: Why didn't I think of it at once!

examples.text: Какой глупый человек догадался это сделать?
examples.trans: What foolish person thought of doing that?

examples.text: Ты никогда сам не догадаешься об этом.
examples.trans: You will never guess this by yourself.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'порить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to argue, to dispute', paired with 'поспорить'.

examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue.

examples.text: Это кошмар, я не спорю. Но зачем на видео снимать?

disbelief

meanings.note: instrumental of вечер used as an adverb

examples.trans: I'm at home in the evening.

повторить.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

meanings.en: to repeat, to say or do again
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to go over again', paired with 'повторять'.

examples.trans: Right, let's go over it again.
So, repeat that clearly once more.

meanings.note: prepared food, course
large flat serving dish

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

meanings.note: diminutive of кусок

meanings.note: + past tense: 'чтобы свидетели были'
+ infinitive

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.

meanings.note: examine likeness or difference

examples.text: Возьми кусочек, чтобы сравнивать свой вкус.
examples.trans: Take a piece so that you can compare your taste.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: не в моём вкусе = not my type
не в моём вкусе = not my type

examples.trans: I would be glad to help you. But unfortunately you are not my type.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

meanings.note: дай! = give (me)!

meanings.note: how something is done
as an answer
Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лучить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get, to receive', paired with 'получать'.

examples.text: А кто их получит? Те, кто сидит повыше?
examples.trans: And who will get it? The people who sit higher up?

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.en: to agree, to come to an arrangement
meanings.note: 'договоримся' = we'll work something out

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to bring (carrying)', paired with 'приносить'.

examples.trans: What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
